mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO daily_quizzes (quiz_date, quiz_question_id) SELECT #{quizDate}, id FROM quiz_questions WHERE active = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM daily_quizzes WHERE daily_quizzes.quiz_question_id = quiz_questions.id ) ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT dq.quiz_date, qq.id AS quiz_question_id, qq.quiz_type, qq.question, qc.id AS choice_id, qc.content AS choice_content, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM user_quiz_attempts uqa WHERE uqa.user_id = #{userId} AND uqa.quiz_date = dq.quiz_date ) AS attempted FROM daily_quizzes dq INNER JOIN quiz_questions qq ON qq.id = dq.quiz_question_id INNER JOIN quiz_choices qc ON qc.question_id = qq.id WHERE dq.quiz_date = #{quizDate} ORDER BY qc.id ASC

SELECT selected_choice.is_correct AS correct, correct_choice.content AS correct_choice_content, qq.explanation FROM quiz_questions qq INNER JOIN quiz_choices selected_choice ON selected_choice.question_id = qq.id AND selected_choice.id = #{selectedChoiceId} INNER JOIN quiz_choices correct_choice ON correct_choice.question_id = qq.id AND correct_choice.is_correct = TRUE WHERE qq.id = #{quizQuestionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_quiz_attempts ( user_id, quiz_date, quiz_question_id, selected_choice_id, is_correct ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{quizDate}, #{quizQuestionId}, #{selectedChoiceId}, #{correct} )
mapper.update: UPDATE coin_wallets SET balance = balance + #{amount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT uqa.quiz_date, uqa.quiz_question_id, qq.question, uqa.is_correct AS correct, CASE WHEN uqa.is_correct THEN 50 ELSE 0 END AS earned_point FROM user_quiz_attempts uqa INNER JOIN quiz_questions qq ON qq.id = uqa.quiz_question_id WHERE uqa.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uqa.quiz_date DESC
